d: New Yorker staff writer Jon Lee Anderson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez is navigating an extraordinary relationship with Washington after the US captured Nicolás Maduro, as she seeks to preserve power while moving away from parts of the country’s socialist legacy. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Anderson discusses Rodríguez’s political evolution, questions surrounding her role in Maduro’s removal and whether Venezuela’s deepening ties with the US can survive a future change in American leadership.
